newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends at a new record, lifted by Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends at a new record, lifted by Dow.

text.p: Leading UK shares scaled new peaks on Friday, inspired by bullish Wall Street and shrugging off uncertainties created by the Labour Party's historic sweep to power.
The benchmark index rose early on, defying initial expectations for big drop, and then gathered pace in the final hours of the session as Wall Street leapt.

The blue chip index added 10.6 points to close at 4,455.6, as advancers led decliners by a margin of about five to three. But trading was relatively light, with SEAQ volume registering only 569.5 million shares at 1539 GMT.
